title: Auto Glass Services Customer Accounts and Warranty Schedule
content:
Customer accounts schedule for **Auto Glass Services** at Crestline Collision & Glass: the payment methods accepted from the customer, the refund period for an overpayment, the desk's goodwill credit authority per job, fleet payment terms, the glass part defect coverage period and the warranty plan issued on completion, by tier.

**Accepted payment methods** — payment methods accepted from the customer (list).
**Refund period** — business days to refund an overpayment (integer).
**Goodwill credit authority** — most the desk may credit as goodwill on one job (USD).
**Fleet payment terms** — calendar days after completion for a fleet account to pay (integer).
**Glass part defect coverage** — months the glass itself is covered against manufacturing defects such as distortion (integer; 0 means not applicable).
**Warranty plan issued** — official name of the warranty issued on completion.

## Payment, refund and goodwill

| Tier | Accepted payment methods | Refund period (business days) | Goodwill credit authority per job (USD) | Fleet payment terms (calendar days after completion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | card, cash | 5 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Side Glass Replacement | card, cash, check | 5 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | card, cash, check | 5 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Windshield Replacement | card, cash, check | 5 | 35.00 | 30 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | card, cash, check | 5 | 45.00 | 30 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | card, cash, check | 5 | 60.00 | 30 |

## Glass defect coverage and warranty plan

| Tier | Glass part defect coverage (months) | Warranty plan issued |
|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 0 | Chip Repair Guarantee |
| Side Glass Replacement | 12 | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 12 | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty |
| Windshield Replacement | 12 | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 12 | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 24 | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty |

## Schedule questions answered

**Which tier does not accept checks?** Windshield Chip Repair accepts card and cash only; the other five tiers accept card, cash and check.

**What goodwill credit authority does each tier carry?** 10.00 on Windshield Chip Repair, 25.00 on Side Glass Replacement and Rear Glass Replacement, 35.00 on Windshield Replacement, 45.00 on Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement and 60.00 on Premium Feature Windshield Replacement, in each case per job.

**How long is glass part defect coverage?** 0 on Windshield Chip Repair, meaning not applicable; 12 months on Side Glass Replacement, Rear Glass Replacement, Windshield Replacement and Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement; 24 months on Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.

**Which warranty plan is issued?** The Chip Repair Guarantee on Windshield Chip Repair, and the Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty on every replacement tier.

**Do the refund period and fleet terms vary by tier?** No: 5 business days to refund an overpayment and 30 calendar days after completion for a fleet account to pay, on every tier.
